'''Tad Kandel''' was a [[Redarm]] in the [[Band of the Red Hand]]. He is from [[Andor]].

== Appearance ==
He was dark skinned.

== Activities ==
It was found out by [[Elayne Trakand|Elayne]] that he had deloped a boil on his backside, which had to be lanced on the way to [[Ebou Dar]]. While at the building that contained the ''[[ter'angreal]]'' [[Bowl of the Winds]] in Ebou Dar, he was killed by the ''[[gholam]]''.
